title: Dream Studio grader verdict — migration role
description: The migration grader's I/O contract (migration-class work orders only). A conformant migration provider returns a JSON object carrying migration_score in [0,1] plus its role-specific payload (the migration_safe flag and the risks list). Extra fields are allowed. Requiring the role's own score is what distinguishes this from the other three role contracts (WO-VERIFY-CONFORMANCE gap 0a64cf8c).
